AWPTCM-T43854.objective:
• With DNS relay enabled (ip dns forwarding) and name-servers configured, the switch forwards DNS query packets to the configured DNS server(s) and returns responses.
  • Disabling DNS relay (no ip dns forwarding) stops DNS query forwarding; name resolution may still work via local resolver if configured.
  • Cycling enable/disable (about 5 times) confirms the feature toggles correctly without issues.
  • Show commands (e.g. show ip dns forwarding) accurately reflect the configuration and status.
  • DNS relay supports global configuration and works with name resolver features when enabled.

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: AWP-3360 (DNS Relay enable/disable). Top relevant: AWP-3359 (name resolver support), AWP-3194 (show commands), AWP-3197 (debug), AWP-3365 (source interface). ART: 1346.1001.87/1346.1010.9 (DNS forwarding config/CLI output) + related DNS suites (13xx/20xx).
Configure name-servers. Enable dns relay (ip dns forwarding). Confirm DNS packets are forwarded through the switch (resolved requests cached).
Disable dns relay (no ip dns forwarding). Confirm relaying stops. Cycle enable/disable about 5 times.
Verify name resolver lookups succeed if dns-server(s) configured. Confirm show commands output is accurate and useful.
